Hi all,

Below are the detailed answers to the logging/retention questions Anna sent. I've included policy-level notes and what we can deliver programmatically. Where relevant I've noted default and configurable retention windows.

1) Audit log classes and retention (default / configurable up to):
- Authentication and user-management events (login attempts, token issues, SSO events): default 90 days / configurable up to 7 years.
- API request metadata (request id, timestamp, route, latency, error codes, caller_id): default 180 days / configurable up to 5 years.
- Model I/O logs (sanitized prompt/response metadata, non-identifiable tokens): default 30 days / configurable to 2 years.
- Full request payloads (customer option): by default not retained; can be enabled per-customer with explicit opt-in and retained up to 1 year.
- Configuration changes and deployment events (model rollouts, config diffs): default 3 years / configurable up to 7 years.

2) Exportability and programmatic access:
- All audit classes are exportable via our Audit Export API. Supported formats: JSONL, CSV, and gzipped JSONL for large exports.
- Exports can be scoped by time range, event class, and request id.
- For large eDiscovery requests we provide a signed URL to download archived exports from a time-limited S3 bucket.
- KV cache and model runtime snapshots: we can provide operational snapshots (metadata and cache identifiers). We do not provide raw GPU memory dumps; we provide sanitized cache exports that include token indices and non-sensitive metadata in JSON.

3) Access controls and internal Redwoods access:
- Principle of least privilege enforced via RBAC and audited admin sessions.
- Strong separation: access to identifiable model inputs/outputs requires an approved access request and is logged to an immutable access ledger.
- We offer Customer Managed Keys (CMK) for encryption at rest; logs can be encrypted with customer keys to limit Redwoods' ability to read plaintext without key access.

4) Legal hold / eDiscovery
- We support hold requests that extend retention windows and prevent deletion. Holds are applied at account or route level. Export packages for legal teams are available in signed, time-limited archives.

5) Compliance artifacts
- We attached a SOC2 extract with the controls that map to our logging and retention practices. Full reports are available under NDA.

Notes / limitations:
- Model outputs that contain PII: we recommend customers either (a) use in-flight redaction rules, (b) enable retention opt-in per route, or (c) use private deployment (VPC) where data routing policies can be enforced on-prem.
- Real-time streaming logs for high-throughput workloads may incur additional costs; batching and sampling tools are available.

Attachment: SOC2-Audit-Extract.pdf (pdf)

Happy to expand any of the sections or provide a sanitized sample export.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Security & Compliance
